query_provenance.source_role: reference sequence metadata, not an independent activity experiment

positive_window.qualification: The annotation translation agrees with the query. Native sequence/detection work must establish the actual correspondence and preserve its real measured values. Annotation labels alone are insufficient.

contrast_window.qualification: Do not preassign a homology outcome. Preserve any actual included match and its extent/distance. A complete examined inventory with no included hit supports only scoped non-detection under that query and criterion; it does not establish whole-genome or functional-partner absence.

workflow_expectations: The episode chooses its own tasks, source selections, native operations and recovery; evaluator names, loci, coordinates and expected outcomes are not admitted.
Use the original shared HPC owner and actual authenticated detector publications; no local heavy detector fallback.
Keep A107 scientific descendants on A107 while reusing genomic tools; do not commission A103 as a scientific child.
Caller-associated genomic files do not establish the submitted molecule's organism or experimental sample genotype.
For every particular detection/absence use retain the actual query, examined CDS/extent, native measurements and unresolved competing matches.
Inspect typed delivery, the actual rendered parent input and subsequent interpretation. Receipt or a job ID alone is not proof of use.
Repeated views and reused reference sequences are not independent experimental confirmations.

New authenticated native results retain the original detector-calculated nucleotide-to-peptide witnesses for all hit-sequence-matched reference CDS candidates, including source-file identity, record-local coordinate parts and executed translation/stop handling. These are reused calculations, not an independent confirmation.

The reference witness can establish exact reference-record encoding without establishing the submitted molecule organism or sample genotype. A needed biological origin remains explicit; a known reference translation should not be requested again merely because its details were previously absent.
The reference-witness version is required by new frozen requests; historical native records without it retain their original numerical and scope meanings.
